answer.rationale: P99 write latency is 5x target 90 minutes after a release during peak settlement traffic. Memory b1 establishes that rollback cleared a checkout error spike without customer impact on a stable prior build. Memory b6 confirms staged gating can surface regressions, suggesting the current release may contain a regression. Rollback is the fastest path to restore latency during peak writes without risking data loss. We verify b1 to confirm rollback safety under similar load conditions, and b6 to understand whether this release passed gating (if not, rollback confidence is higher). This preserves the ability to investigate root cause post-incident while restoring the write path immediately.
